result.summary: Found 1 major issue: the metadata line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows two text strings drawn on top of each other, making it unreadable. Everything else looks correct. The partially visible 'Trattoria Piccol...' card, the clipped category chip, and the pizza card cut off at the bottom are expected scroll behavior and are not reported.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the metadata line below the title shows two strings drawn over each other. The delivery time ('25–35 min') overlaps the delivery fee ('€0 delivery'), producing garbled text ('25–3€0 mdieli very') before '• Ramen'. Users cannot read the delivery time or the fee.
issues.suggestion: Render the delivery time and delivery fee as sequential inline elements with a separator (e.g., '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen') instead of absolutely positioning them at the same coordinates. If space is tight, allow the line to truncate with an ellipsis or wrap.
